task: A template that reads a variable passed to render() and then assigns the same name with set in every branch of an if/elif/else, e.g. {% if True %}{{ a.b }}{% set a = 1 %}{% elif False %}{% set a = 2 %}{% else %}{% set a = 3 %}{% endif %}{{ a }}, raises UndefinedError ("'a' is undefined") when rendered with a={'b': 0}. Expected output is "01".
